components.title: Canonical types and serialization
components.boundary: Pure contract library; no OS handles, UI, model calls or mutable state.
components.owns: Own strict records, identifiers, canonical byte rules, version dispatch and deterministic validation errors.
components.evidence_limits: Pure leaf contracts including framing and memory metadata binding only; full contract, domain state, current authority, transport and runtime incomplete.

components.title: Deterministic governance and transition kernel
components.boundary: Trusted control boundary; the only positive-authority decision owner.
components.owns: Own admissibility, authority and policy evaluation, transition predicates, consent binding and single-use permit state.

components.title: Canonical history and projections
components.boundary: Protected store adapter accessible to the trusted application service, never model workers.
components.owns: Own durable commit mechanics, per-scope ordered streams, optimistic revisions, outbox transactions and derivable projections.

components.title: Identity, trusted approvals and time
components.boundary: Credential and trusted-approval boundary with narrowly exposed operations.
components.owns: Own technical identity lookup, authentication bindings, key references, session/boot generations and approval ceremony verification.

components.title: Supervisor, queues and owned lifetimes
components.boundary: Application supervisor with bounded lifecycle privileges; requests authority from kernel.
components.owns: Own event dispatch leases, task wakeups, service lifetimes, stop coordination and health reporting.

components.title: Scoped observation and reconciliation
components.boundary: Least-authority read workers with explicit subscriptions.
components.owns: Own observations of selected resources, change hints, reconciliation scans and source completeness.

components.title: Intake and exact context compiler
components.boundary: Cognitive preparation boundary; no general tools or permit issuance.
components.owns: Own original-request preservation, interpretation records, scope-aware retrieval assembly and exact prepared payload.

components.title: Fates, retrieval and cognitive graph
components.boundary: Scoped payload/index storage; mutations admitted by the kernel.
components.owns: Own candidate creation, relevance weighting, lifecycle proposals and permission-filtered derived indexes.

components.title: Partner-facing intelligence
components.boundary: Untrusted reasoner relative to effect authority, using a qualified inference worker.
components.owns: Own conversation and explanation use cases, decision-support rationale and technical identity presentation.

components.title: Sovereign Interior Vault
components.boundary: Isolated exploratory workspace with no production effect route.
components.owns: Own finite speculative sessions and proposition formation.

components.title: Shadow Thirst staging
components.boundary: Hostile-code containment with disposable workspace and no real credentials.
components.owns: Own governed proposal IR, candidate bytes, simulation records and predicted-versus-observed comparisons.

components.title: Galahad, Cerberus and Codex review
components.boundary: Bounded review workers; protected authority remains in kernel.
components.owns: Own attributable identity/consent, security/survival and constitutional findings with dissent.

components.title: Constrained orchestration and TAAR adaptation
components.boundary: Pure graph compiler plus kernel-owned scheduling use cases.
components.owns: Own typed graph semantics and compute legal readiness without independent permission state.

components.title: Effect broker and adapters
components.boundary: OS-enforced broker/worker boundary; no unrestricted generic execution RPC.
components.owns: Own bounded effect performance after kernel admission and exact adapter dispatch.

components.title: Independent outcome observation and evidence checks
components.boundary: Distinct observing/verifying role with separately described independence.
components.owns: Own checks of actual postconditions and evidence bundles; kernel settles state.

components.title: CETA-owned local model execution
components.boundary: Contained inference worker behind owned lifecycle and residency lease.
components.owns: Own pinned model execution, exact tokenizer/template contract and measured backend state.

components.title: Asset custody and resource admission
components.boundary: Explicit acquisition workers; no model-pack code execution.
components.owns: Own verified downloads/imports, manifests, licenses, storage staging and hardware observations.

components.title: Defensive Vault
components.boundary: Dedicated protected object service, never a tool launcher.
components.owns: Own object admission, seal/release lifecycle, protected metadata and custody evidence.

components.title: Distributed cryptographic authority
components.boundary: Independently administered authority domains plus sealed operation worker.
components.owns: Own threshold protocol participation and proof checks within each independent domain.

components.title: NIRL monitoring and Chimera isolation
components.boundary: Technical signal monitor plus visibly isolated containment lane.
components.owns: Own evidence-backed signal detection and containment recommendations.

components.title: Native desktop and trusted interaction
components.boundary: PySide6 host and explicitly trusted approval surface; no core authority writes.
components.owns: Own presentation, user input, real actions, approvals, accessibility and honest status.

components.title: Voice, selected-screen and external adapters
components.boundary: Opt-in capture/connector workers with explicit scope and retention.
components.owns: Own device observations and interface adaptation, not separate assistants.

components.title: Legacy import and coherent cutover
components.boundary: Read-mostly conversion boundary plus separately authorized cutover tooling.
components.owns: Own source snapshots, mapping, conversion, quarantine and restoration rehearsals.

components.title: Build, release and maintenance
components.boundary: Reproducible build tooling and separately authorized publisher actions.
components.owns: Own candidate assembly, dependency closure, signed update protocol and artifact provenance.

components.title: Quality, drift and training lifecycle
components.boundary: Isolated evaluator/training process with budgeted data access.
components.owns: Own test corpus lineage, scoring, candidate qualification proposals and optional authorized training.
